the isolates of P. syringae pv savastanoi recovered from leaves of a particular type at a particular time of the year are more alike than those from leaves of a different type at the same time or leaves of the same or different type at different times of the year.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Pseudomonas isolates from the phyllosphere of olive plants are genetically diverse, but that the diversity is not random.
the phylloplanic population of Pseudomonasa syringae pv.savastanoi is highly variable and the isolates are not distributed at random in the population.
the olive phylloplane may be a reservoir of Pseudomonasa syringae pv savastanoi strains which are not pathogenic to olive.
